column3: What is the batting average of Ruturaj Gaikwad in T20 matches?
column4:
SELECT CAST(SUM(b.score__runs) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(b.score__out AS INT)), 0) AS batting_average
FROM history2.fixtures__balls b
WHERE b.batsman__fullname = 'Ruturaj Gaikwad'
column5:
